_comment: Chrome overlay. Merged over manifests/base.json by scripts/build.mjs.
`key` pins the extension ID so removing and re-adding an unpacked build
keeps its chrome.storage namespace (M2). It is the public half of a
generated keypair — the private half was never written to disk, because
unpacked loading does not need it. It MUST be deleted before a Chrome Web
Store upload: the store assigns its own identity and rejects the field.
`background.service_worker` is Chrome's MV3 background. Firefox has no
service-worker background in MV3 and uses `scripts` instead, which is why
these two manifests differ at all.
